name: Inositol
description: Small cell-signalling molecule, sometimes called a pseudovitamin; the “I” in MIC injection blends

status.studiedFor: No studies found for energy or fat loss
status.humanEvidence: No human studies found for this use
status.usStatus: Not FDA approved · compounding under review

note.text: No published human study of injected inositol, alone or in MIC blends, for energy or fat loss was found.

bullets: Used by the body in **cell signalling**; no recognized deficiency disease
The **“I” in MIC** (methionine, inositol, choline) injections
**In people,** a mechanism for energy or fat loss is not established
No human study of inositol injections found
No study of MIC blends for energy or fat loss
Lab and animal work not reviewed for this use

practical.soldAs: Compounded (Rx) MIC and lipotropic blends; not FDA approved

regulatory.text: No approved product; 503B nomination under review
Not listed; IV over 100 mL per 12 h banned (M2.2)

references: FDA, Bulk drug substances nominated under section 503B (categories), Mar 2025
FDA, drug recall enforcement reports, lipotropic and MIC products (openFDA), Oct 2026
